implementedBehavior: Sports venue results pass an explicit ListingCard presentation: family mode uses O08's oorva layout for complete titles/prices; either selector OFF explicitly passes legacy. The displayed minimum is labeled From and per slot, with only returned area, city, distance, and verification metadata.
Sports activity cards use a one-column layout on narrow viewports or enlarged text, otherwise two columns, and activity titles are not line-clamped.

The family venue-selection composition renders one hero, compact venue identity, then resource/date/slot selection. Additional photos expand below selection; OFF retains the legacy photo and detail ordering.

Sports booking history uses the existing booking presentation helper and supplied booking fields; family mode emphasizes the actual start–end range before stored amount/payment, while either selector OFF explicitly uses the existing legacy card.

The existing sticky booking footer, route/params, booking action, server amount, idempotency, permissions, cancellation, refund, and expiry behavior were not changed. No registry, migration, SQL, shared ListingCard default, or route-wrapper edits.
